desc: Compute standard max subarray sum using Kadane (no removal case).
Group indices by value `x` (dict mapping value -> list of indices).
Build a segment tree for range max subarray sum queries (node: total, max_prefix, max_suffix, max_subarray).
For each distinct value `x` that does not appear everywhere, find all x-free intervals (between consecutive occurrences, plus before first and after last).
For each x-free interval [l, r] (non-empty), query the segment tree to get its max subarray sum, and update the answer for `x`.
Also consider the case of no removal (standard max subarray sum).
Return the maximum over all `x` and the no-removal case.
Test the implementation with the provided examples and edge cases (e.g., all negative numbers, single element, all same values) to ensure correctness.
Optimize the segment tree merge and query functions if needed for clarity and performance.
